description.value: My Toan is a chain of modern Vietnamese restaurants founded by a Vietnamese-Canadian entrepreneur who brought traditional recipes from his hometown to BC over 30 years ago. The menu centres on pho-style noodle soups, rice and vermicelli combinations, Vietnamese crepes, and baguettes. The OSM node is tagged at basement level (-1), consistent with its food-court locations inside Harbour Centre and Waterfront Centre in downtown Vancouver.
